Join the group

Build what mission-critical
systems depend on.

More than 800 people across Israel, Thailand and India build the cables, connectors and assemblies that hospitals, aircraft and defense systems rely on every day.

Why ARNIR

A group that has grown every decade since 1993.

What started as a single cable-harness factory in Israel is now five companies across three countries. That growth is the reason there is room here – on the production floor, in engineering and in quality.

Each company keeps its own strengths and specialties while operating with a shared vision of sustainability and customer satisfaction.

800+People across Israel, Thailand and India
5Companies, on three production continents
30+Years of continuous operation and growth

How we work

Trained, certified, and trusted with the hard parts.

All of our operators are IPC-620 certified and trained in comprehensive harness assembly techniques. Every member of the team brings specialised skills to a build that has to pass stringent QA before it leaves the floor.

Our factories are equipped with advanced machinery for cutting, stripping, crimping, soldering, molding and electrical and mechanical testing – and every site is certified to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485:2016 and AS9100D.

Engineered connectivity for medical, defense and industrial technology – since 1993.
